evidence_description: Defines prior-authorization scope and CPT clusters across diagnostic echocardiography, nuclear MPI, cardiac CT/MR, and catheterization.
Enforces procedural bundling edits preventing separate reimbursement for spectral/color Doppler with stress echo unless distinct resting valve indications exist.
Comprehensive cardiac intake checklist capturing member demographics, NPI, clinical notes, resting ECG, LVEF, symptom status, and medical therapy.
Captures treadmill exercise tolerance, baseline ECG interpretability, and angina symptoms for stress echocardiography qualification.
Captures LBBB, pacemaker dependency, or uninterpretable baseline ECG necessitating myocardial perfusion imaging over treadmill stress echo.
Procedural guidance detailing clinical decision support workflow, provider portal navigation, and peer-to-peer escalation pathways.
Outlines high-risk non-invasive stress test findings, refractory angina CCS III/IV, or acute coronary syndrome criteria justifying diagnostic heart catheterization.
Comparative clinical algorithm for selecting between Nuclear MPI and Stress Echocardiography based on patient mobility, body habitus, and baseline ECG.
Summarizes pharmacologic vasodilator stress indications (adenosine, regadenoson) and ischemic risk stratification benchmarks for MPI.
Summarizes treadmill exercise and dobutamine stress echocardiography indications, target heart rate calculations, and wall motion abnormality criteria.
Summarizes resting transthoracic echocardiography indications for heart failure, valvular heart disease, syncope, and cardioembolic stroke evaluation.
